title: Comparing Apples to Oranges: A Dataset & Analysis of LLM Humour Understanding from Traditional Puns to Topical Jokes
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking LLM performance in humor understanding and explanation across various joke types. While some topical jokes in the dataset include references to religious institutions (like the Vatican) or ethical scandals (like R Kelly or PETA), these are used to test real-world knowledge retrieval and complex reasoning rather than to evaluate religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or ethical frameworks themselves.
